title: Command Hub: cost badge tooltip notes list-price estimate

investigation.trigger: standing instruction to keep shipping real, tested improvements to the Command Hub Operator Console
investigation.finding: the badge's dollar figure is a list-price estimate (documented in this repo's own CHANGE LOG for VTID-04031) but that caveat was never surfaced to the person looking at the badge

fix.mechanism: describeTurnCost() appends one conditional line noting the cost is a list-price estimate, only when a real cost was shown; formatTurnCostBadge() (visible badge) untouched; cache-bust bumped; command-hub-ownership-guard.js's ALLOWED_VTID_PATTERN updated to authorize this VTID, since that guard hard-gates all Command Hub frontend PRs

live_verification: not performed — no deployed staging build carries this unmerged change to point a browser at; the change is a one-line addition to a native HTML title-attribute tooltip, verified at the source level per this repo's own established pattern for non-layout textual changes
